messages.subject: DP World | Government relations and stakeholder execution around growth markets
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Vissat,

Given your communications role across DP World's Americas platform, I would appreciate your placing this confidential executive note before Mr. Daniel Van Otterdijk, Group Chief Communications & Government Relations Officer.

DP World's growth model depends on more than ports and logistics. Economic zones, industrial hubs and integrated supply chains require durable government relationships, public-policy alignment, investment attraction and stakeholder confidence around each market. Your remit across government relations, public affairs, partnerships, reputation and executive communications makes those interfaces central to the Group's ability to execute.

The Americas illustrate the opportunity clearly. Programs such as the Dominican Republic hub combine major capital investment, government partnership, industrial-zone expansion and new economic activity. Similar platforms benefit from a country-level external-affairs model that keeps institutional relationships, regulatory commitments, local participation and stakeholder issues connected to commercial and operating priorities.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate brings together government and regulatory relations, corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy, ESG and social performance, executive advisory and cross-functional action closure in a high-scrutiny industrial environment. I work across ministries, regulators, communities, contractors and operating teams, translating external requirements into accountable delivery.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this profile might strengthen DP World's government relations, regional corporate affairs, strategic partnerships, country operations or market-entry execution, particularly across the Americas and other emerging markets. My attached CV is prepared specifically around that fit.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
